description: An English-speaking student who switches to Roman Urdu for one message and back: chat_language follows each turn.

writer: Hi, I am PAI, your counselor. Tell me about yourself: what do you do these days, and what matters to you?

turns.student: I am doing A-levels, I love painting and I volunteer at an animal shelter.
writer: Painting and caring for animals both take patience and attention to detail. How would your friends describe you?

extract.quote: I volunteer at an animal shelter

turns.student: Mere dost kehte hain main bohat patient hoon.
writer: Sabr un kaamon mein kaam aata hai jahan cheezein dheere dheere banti hain. Koi aisi cheez hai jo tumne achieve ki ho aur tumhare liye matter karti ho?

turns.student: Back to English: I won a district art prize last year.
writer: A district prize means your work held up next to many others. Which A-level subjects are you taking, and how are your grades so far?

extract.quote: I won a district art prize last year
